subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Frozen Forecasts
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Frozen Forecasts.

hook.text: The forecast was locked in January. By March, the market had shifted completely. But the plan hadn't.

buildup.text: Frozen forecasts are plans locked for a period to stabilize production and supply decisions.

discovery.text: Freezing prevents constant changes that disrupt operations. Stability has real value in manufacturing.

twist.text: Freezing too long ignores market changes. Freezing too short destabilizes operations. Balance is key.

climax.text: Best practice: freeze near-term (1–2 weeks), flex medium-term, and replan long-term monthly.

punchline.text: Lock the plan close in. Keep it flexible further out.

quiz.question: What is the risk of freezing forecasts too long?
